Finding #1 (courtyard clearance, should-fix) - FIXED. Auditor was right that the round-0 report's clearance numbers used SHAPE_POLY_SET.BBox() (pads +0.05mm/side), inconsistent with apply_placement.py's real-polygon overlap gate. Re-measured with a new true polygon-vertex-distance tool (min segment-to-segment distance over the actual GetCourtyard() outlines) and confirmed the auditor's 3 real failures, all involving C302: C302<->U303 0.460mm, C302<->U302 0.465mm, C302<->R304 0.494mm (root cause: C302's pocket was 1.835mm wide but needed 1.91mm for its 0.91mm width plus 0.5mm clearance each side - short by 0.075mm). Fixed by widening the pocket (U302 +0.25mm additional x-shift, still 1.025mm total, well under the 3mm anchor budget) and re-centering C302; also happened to make C302's decoupling loop to U302 pin6 a clean horizontal 1.4875mm. New measurements: C302<->U303 0.5875mm, C302<->U302 0.5875mm, C302<->R304 0.9740mm - all pass, and every other pairwise gap in the block re-verified >=0.5mm with the same true-distance tool.

Finding #2 (decoupling-cap ground-return path, should-fix) - FIXED for C301, explained/bounded for C302/C303/C304. U301's V+ pin and its nearest GND pin happen to sit stacked 0.5mm apart vertically; round 0 placed C301 with pads side-by-side (rot 0), so only the hot side was close. Rotating C301 to 270 deg lines its own pad pitch up with that vertical pin pitch: both distances now 1.505mm (was 1.467mm hot / 2.478mm ground) - symmetric, matches TI SBOS473L's explicit "close to supply AND ground pins" text. For C302 (VEML6031X00) and C303/C304 (DRV2605L), the IC packages themselves put the nearest same-net GND pin 1.0-1.5mm from the relevant supply/REG pin along the package edge/diagonal (measured directly: U302 pin6->nearest GND 1.2313mm; U303 pin10->nearest GND 1.0000mm; U303 pin1(REG)->nearest GND 1.5000mm) - since the cap must stay >=0.5mm outside the courtyard, this pin-to-pin pitch is a floor no cap placement can beat.
